title: Find where work is lost
description: Read the platform's pipeline hop by hop at 0, open a hop's explainer, break a simulated panel and watch the outage land on the panel while the outpost hop stays at 0, then follow a component's row to its delivery series.

steps.caption: Platform health draws the path a sample takes from its run to the store, one hop at a time.
Each hop shows what it took in, what it handed on, and the share it lost. 0% is healthy.
Open the ingest hop. It says what counts as lost there, the keys it is read from, and the server component that records it.
Every hop is read from the same three keys, one series per kind, so one rule reads them all.
Touch Panel 2 is simulated, so it can be broken on purpose.
Impairments are set on their own tab.
Unplug it. It goes dark, so nothing can reach it.
Save. The simulator applies it on its next pull.
The outage lands on the panel's own component. It reads down, and its polls are held, not run.
Back on Platform health, Where work is lost still open.
Every hop still reads 0%. A device that did not answer is not work the platform dropped. A hop that does lose a share is tinted, so it stands out.
Open the outpost hop. Each outpost's own share is a row.
Follow the outpost's row to its platform component.
The outpost's delivery series live on its component, one per kind, like any other metric.
